label: Civic & Institutional
description: Public rooms with rules: the places a story needs when it stops being about scenery. Hospitals, courts, schools, stations and the counters people queue at.

items.name: hospital-corridor
items.text: A hospital corridor in flat overhead light, a polished vinyl floor running to a distant double door, a gurney parked against the wall.

items.name: operating-theatre
items.text: An operating theatre under a cluster of surgical lamps, stainless trolleys laid out in order, green drapes and a monitor tracing steadily.

items.name: courtroom
items.text: A courtroom in dark panelled wood, a raised bench and empty jury box, rows of public benches and a stenographer's small table.

items.name: school-corridor
items.text: A school corridor lined with dented lockers, scuffed floor tiles, noticeboards layered with paper and daylight from a door at the end.

items.name: lecture-hall
items.text: A raked lecture hall of fold-down seats, a long whiteboard still half-written, a projector beam cutting the chalk-dry air.

items.name: library-reading-room
items.text: A library reading room under a vaulted ceiling, green-shaded lamps down long tables, galleries of shelves and complete silence.

items.name: church-nave
items.text: A church nave in cool stone, light falling in coloured panels across the pews, candle racks glowing at the side aisles.
items.text_short: stone church nave, coloured light on pews

items.name: town-hall-chamber
items.text: A civic chamber in carved oak, a horseshoe of desks with brass name plates, portraits above and a public gallery behind railings.

items.name: police-station-desk
items.text: A police station front desk behind reinforced glass, a strip-lit waiting bench, wanted notices curling and a clock running loud.

items.name: supermarket-aisle
items.text: A supermarket aisle in cold even light, shelves stacked to a vanishing point, a trolley abandoned mid-row and price tape everywhere.
items.text_short: supermarket aisle in cold even light

items.name: post-office-counter
items.text: A post office counter with numbered windows, a snaking rope queue, franked parcels stacked and a pen chained to the writing shelf.
items.text_short: post office counter with a rope queue

items.name: station-concourse
items.text: A station concourse under a glazed roof, a split-flap board clattering over a moving crowd, pigeons in the girders and light shafting down.

items.name: museum-gallery
items.text: A museum gallery of pale walls and picture lights, a bench at the centre, floor markings keeping visitors back from the frames.
items.text_short: pale museum gallery with picture lights

items.name: playground
items.text: A playground of rubber matting and repainted steel, swings turning slightly on their chains, a climbing frame and a chalked hopscotch.

items.name: municipal-pool
items.text: A municipal swimming pool hall, ceramic tile and lane ropes, light bouncing off water onto a high ceiling and echo on everything.

items.name: waiting-room
items.text: A waiting room of bolted plastic chairs, a ticket display above the door, old magazines fanned on a low table and one window blind askew.
items.text_short: waiting room of bolted plastic chairs
